text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as preparations for the overseas campaign steadily progressed and the travel dates were set.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You've been a good kid these past few years. Well done.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Before we head out of Japan—
I oughta give ya a "reward," shouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ended up going to a hot spring inn together with Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Here, puppy, a treat.
It's a flavor you'll love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before heading to the inn, we decided to take a stroll
around the surrounding resort area, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call it an escort, exactly,
but she's being unusually gentle for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The trip is officially a "reward"—
but even so, I wonder if this is truly alright.
choice_data_list: You really don't have to treat this as a 'reward'...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
It's not like I did anything that special.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Besides, well—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You were a pretty ideal puppy,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing her murmur that made me wonder.
choice_data_list: What would be the ideal puppy for Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, she didn't really understand
what was being praised or why.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When it comes to overseas campaigns, the situations where a Trainer must provide support increase. If there are areas where I've been helpful, I'd like to know.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Who knows?
Guess right, and maybe I'll tell you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, when I was chosen as her Trainer,
points like that were considered key factors.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
Though that's not all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...There are at least 2 more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, our 'Ideal Puppy' quiz continued
as we enjoyed the rest of our trip."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, what's wrong?
Can't even bear to be apart from your master during bath time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It came to me while soaking in the tub. Setting aside whether I live up to it myself, it's something every Trainer ought to have—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Nope.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief,
getting so worked up over a quiz like that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"We're gettin' nowhere. I'll give you a hint.
—What's that thing stuck right in the middle of your face?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
The correct answer is, "Having a sharp nose."
choice_data_list: Huh... I thought it was normal, though...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's a metaphor, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
âBeing able to see what others can'tâ
that's why I respect you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, you'll never figure out the third one.
Just give up gracefully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—That said, once you know two of them,
you can't help but wonder about the rest.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, every answer I gave was wrong,
and every spark of inspiration was scoffed at—
until it was finally time to head home from the trip.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Infatuated with Sirius Symboli,"
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This answer was the result of extensive contemplation
and taking a long, hard look at her own distinct traits.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Nope.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I told you that you wouldn't understand.
Just give it up already.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Why obsess over that so much?
It's not like knowing it would do you any good anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's not the case at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's information I definitely want to know so I can
continue supporting her abroad in the future.
When I explain this reason—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Haa.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You really are something else, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I'm only gonna say this once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a sigh,
—she muttered quietly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ‘To follow me without fail.’

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're never ahead of me.
Nor are you running side by side with me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Yet, whenever I turn around, she's always right there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflected in those sharp, crimson eyes
is a single Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: From here on, a long journey across the sea was about to begin—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...
You don't need to be my light.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Just make sure you don't let go.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Just like always, no matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...You got that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I follow behind her as she advances without hesitation.
Glancing up, a sky full of stars—a beautiful expanse where a blue star shone brightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Sirius Symboli...
